summary: Tessellates Bezier patch control-point data into a collision triangle mesh. Initializes a collision shape buffer, packs input triangle vertices (32-byte stride from a2[2]) into cyclic adjacency via repeated TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder calls, computes collision contact responses, frees the input buffer, allocates a per-patch result index buffer, fits height-above-terrain surface coefficients per patch (HATPolygonSurfaceFit, then sub_44B110 derives a permutation index), writes fitted surface-height doubles into neighbour vertices, and finally builds the output adjacency buffer under a permutation-index switch dispatched through the jpt_44B6EC jump table (cases 0, 1-3 via AxisPermutationMatrixRead, 4 via CollisionFaceVerticesGather), freeing temporaries at the end. Called from CollisionGeometryOperationSelector (0x0044BB60).

local_names.this: collision pipeline object; captured in v65[1]
local_names.a2: input triangle descriptor: a2[0] = patch count, a2[2] = vertex control-point stream
local_names.v65[0]: per-patch permutation-index buffer allocated via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper
local_names.v70/v71/v72/v73/v74..v79: packed vertex arrays and fitted surface coefficients
local_names.v82: four-vertex working pointer set per patch

operations.description: Initialize the local collision shape buffer v69 via CollisionShapeInit.
Allocate the contact buffer for the input patch count: CollisionContactBufferAllocator(v69, 4 * a2[0]).

Per-triangle loop over a2[0] entries: pack the vertex float/double components read at 32-byte stride from the a2[2] control-point stream into the local arrays v70/v73, tag each vertex set with RGBColorPacking(v5, v65), then call TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder four times over the four cyclic permutations of the packed arrays.
Compute collision contact responses from the built adjacency: CollisionContactResponse(v69).
Release the input triangle buffer: PhysicsBufferFree(a2).
Allocate the per-patch result index buffer v65[0] with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(4 * count).

Per-patch loop over the count: run HATPolygonSurfaceFit on each of the four vertices (92-byte output stride, 32-byte input stride), then sub_44B110(v82) derives a permutation index stored into the result index buffer v65[0][v61].

For each patch whose stored permutation index pointer is non-null: gather the face vertices with CollisionFaceVerticesGather(v81, v82), pack a color identifier with RGBColorPacking(v82[0], &v66), copy the capsule collision shape into the pipeline with CollisionCapsuleShapeCopyToPipeline(v81, color, &v74), then loop over the three edges writing fitted surface-height doubles into neighbour vertex fields using the v74..v79 coefficients.
Allocate the output adjacency buffer: CollisionContactBufferAllocator(a3, count).

Per-patch output build: dispatch on the stored permutation index through the jpt_44B6EC jump table (global 0x0044B8F4): case 0 re-gathers vertex components per edge and emits TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder for each of the four edges; cases 1-3 perform two AxisPermutationMatrixRead(v81, v82, perm, k) passes for k in 0..1 then emit TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder; case 4 gathers vertices once with CollisionFaceVerticesGather and emits TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder; default performs no output.
Release the intermediate shape buffer: PhysicsBufferFree(v69).
Free the result index buffer v65[0] via FreeWrapper_7bcf when it is non-null.
Return the result of a final PhysicsBufferFree(v69) release of the local shape buffer.
